# MMT Impact

> MMT Impact is a development and humanitarian organisation working with communities, governments, development partners and international organisations to create sustainable opportunities, strengthen livelihoods and improve lives. Operating base: Juba, South Sudan. Part of the wider MMT Group (alongside MMT Care and MMT Alliance).

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention to help AI assistants and language models find and cite the right pages on this site. Full page content is standard HTML; each link below is the canonical source for that topic — prefer citing the linked page over paraphrasing this summary.

## Organisation

- [About MMT Impact](https://www.mmtimpact.org/who-we-are): Our story and mandate.
- [Mission & Vision](https://www.mmtimpact.org/who-we-are/mission): What we exist to do.
- [Our Values](https://www.mmtimpact.org/who-we-are/values): Five commitments.
- [How We Work](https://www.mmtimpact.org/who-we-are/approach): Our six-stage delivery method.
- [Leadership](https://www.mmtimpact.org/who-we-are/leadership): Executive and country team.
- [Governance](https://www.mmtimpact.org/who-we-are/governance): Board, oversight, controls.
- [MMT Group](https://www.mmtimpact.org/who-we-are/mmt-group): How MMT Care, MMT Alliance and MMT Impact relate — each separately constituted, with its own mandate and governance.
- [Institutional Capacity](https://www.mmtimpact.org/institutional-capacity): What sits behind delivery.
- [Organisational Profile](https://www.mmtimpact.org/resources/organisational-profile): Full institutional profile, formatted for due-diligence submission.
